title: Annotatio V §.V: 1 Cor. chain; epiphonema — If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus, anathema Maranatha
pass_a_gloss: Compare 1 Corinthians 1:10ff.; 2:12; 3:6; 8:9ff.; 9:27; 10:23–24, 33–34; 12:4ff., 25f.; 13 entire; 14:3ff., 40; 16:13–14 — which Epistle he closes with the strongest epiphonema: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus, who alone is true Salvation, saving Truth, let him be anathema, Maranatha.
pass_b_english: He points to a long run of 1 Corinthians (chs. 1–3, 8–10, 12–14, and 16:13–14).
The letter’s strongest closing cry is: anyone who does not love the Lord Jesus — the one true Salvation and saving Truth — is anathema, Maranatha.
source_text: Conf. 1.Cor. I. 10.seq. II. 12. III. 6. VIII. 9.seq. IX. 27. X. 23. 24. 33. 34. XII. 4.seqq. 25.seq. XIII. toto, XIV. 3.seqq. 40. XVI. 13. 14. quam Epistolam finit fortissimo epiphonemate: Si quis Dominum Jesum non amat, qui una est vera Salus est, Salutaris Veritas, sit anathema, Maranatha.
